editorial.blurb: Folklore is an elegant Argentinian steakhouse where candlelit tables and attentive service set the stage for exceptional beef and thoughtfully prepared sides.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the filet—reviewers consistently rave about its tenderness and especially love it with the red wine sauce. Go on a Saturday evening when the dim lighting and candles create an ideal date-night atmosphere.

topDishes.note: Tender and tasty, standout with red wine sauce
